metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an exercise that can give TMJ and jaw pain relief in seconds.

This exercise will focus on actively lengthening and strengthening the muscles of mastication (chewing), which may lead to less tension and strain. It can be done at home, throughout the day, and requires no equipment.

Let us know how it works for you!
